name: Sony BRAVIA XR-65X90J (China)
summary: Sony BRAVIA XR-65X90J China firmware has usage agents, shop mode and hotel apps. TidyTV is a free phone app that turns them off, with a backup and undo.
intro: This is the China-market firmware, without Google Play or the Sony promo rows found on other Sony sets. It does have Sony usage and bug-report uploaders, viewing context providers, shop demo mode, help tiles, camera apps for a camera this model lacks, a JD smart-service app and hotel and business packages.

The Dangbei home screen is kept as the fallback. TidyTV turns the listed apps off from your phone over Wi-Fi, saves a backup first and never deletes anything. Any app can be switched back on, and restore puts everything back in one tap.
keep: Live TV and player app (Sony TV service)
The Dangbei home screen as fallback
HappyCast, the only casting route here
Remote control and device control services
TV updates and DRM key services
notes: The ad surfaces on this firmware are mostly the Dangbei home, its store and the preinstalled content apps, which are not on the list.
The owner used a third-party home screen on this TV.

faq.q: Will it stop the ads on the home screen?
faq.a: Only partly. This firmware has no Sony ad rows to remove. The Dangbei home and content apps are left alone.
Yes. HappyCast is kept. This set has no Google Cast.

faq.q: Can I get the old home screen back?
faq.a: Yes. The Dangbei home screen is never turned off, and Restore everything turns every app back on.
